title: Topic 3.8.2: Parable of the mustard seed

pages.lesson:
LESSON: PARABLE OF THE MUSTARD SEED

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.8.2: Parable of the mustard seed

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Parable of the mustard seed. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How does the parable of the mustard seed relate to the kingdom of God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
2. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
3. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God
4. appreciate the growth of God’s kingdom by evangelising to others

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: PARABLE OF THE MUSTARD SEED
This lesson teaches Parable of the mustard seed for Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. appreciate the growth of God’s kingdom by evangelising to others
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Parable of the mustard seed using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Parable of the mustard seed above.
2. Explain Parable of the mustard seed to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Parable of the mustard seed.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Parable of the mustard seed with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Parable of the mustard seed important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does the parable of the mustard seed relate to the kingdom of God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
2. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
3. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God
4. appreciate the growth of God’s kingdom by evangelising to others
